name: Bottom sheet
summary: The audience sheet that slides up to show one option in full: picture on top, the whole text below.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-bottom-sheet> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css. Open it from the `expand` event of <aha-answer-option expandable>, set `image` and slot the full text. It traps Tab while open and gives focus back to what opened it.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Panel
spec.value: white, 16 radius on the top corners, full width up to 560, never taller than 75% of the screen; grab handle 40×4 centred at the top

spec.label: Body
spec.value: 24 side padding; the picture fills the width (contain, 8 radius) above the text (16/24, long words break); the body scrolls

spec.label: Backdrop
spec.value: black at 40%; pressing it closes the sheet

spec.label: Close
spec.value: the audience close button (tertiary-deck icon-only md with the sheet muted glyph, 16 system-x) top right; it needs the Button tertiary-deck md icon-only variant from pull request 317; also Escape and a swipe down (past 96px or a quick flick)

spec.label: Focus
spec.value: focus moves into the sheet on open, Tab cycles inside it, and focus returns to the opener on close

props.name: open
props.desc: Shows the sheet; the element removes it itself on close

props.name: label / close-label
props.desc: Translated dialog name and close button name

props.name: inline
props.desc: Draws the panel in the page flow with no backdrop, for docs and previews

props.name: close
props.desc: Fires after the sheet closes by backdrop, button, Escape or swipe

whenToUse.when: the audience needs one option in full: long text or a picture seen larger
a decision the user must finish first; never for reading content

opinion.note: Open it from the `expand` event of <aha-answer-option expandable>, not from a pick. A pick never opens it.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, for a build-less slide page.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the inline example (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-bottom-sheet[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var p=cs(q('.panel'));var t=cs(q('.text'));return{panelRadius:p.borderTopLeftRadius,panelBg:p.backgroundColor,textSize:t.fontSize,textLine:t.lineHeight};})()

highlights: Picture on top, full text below
Scrolls when long, never taller than 75% of the screen
Closes on backdrop, close button, Escape and swipe down
